name: Neural Surface Reconstruction and Rendering for LiDAR-Visual Systems
definition: A method that combines LiDAR-derived occupancy maps with neural radiance fields (NeRF) and signed distance fields (SDF) to reconstruct geometry and render appearance, using visible-aware occupancy to classify unknown spaces and spatial-varying scale for adaptive sharpness.
summary: M2Mapping integrates LiDAR occupancy maps with neural fields to reconstruct geometry and render appearance, distinguishing itself by using visible-aware classification and structure-aware sampling to capture sharp details in slim objects.
